texts.head: Is this gap real? Four of five checks say the gap is real. Stage at diagnosis is the one public data cannot answer; the records audit (8 weeks, €8,000) settles it.
texts.strip: Could it be chance? No: less than once in 500. Is it because patients there are older? No: still lower after age adjustment. Are cancers found later there? Cannot tell: not published by county. Is it just missing records? Mostly not: about 8 of 12 remain. Do deaths and survival point the same way? Yes, slightly: more deaths per case.
